<!-- stormworks-research-gap:family:through-drive-rotor -->
This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/parts/through-drive-rotor).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Practical behavior guidance**

> How power splits between the two connections was not recovered.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/154/limitations/0`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Each has two power connections (A and B), which allows rotors to be stacked along one drivetrain; how power divides between them was not recovered.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/154/sections/0/body`

**Definition-only extraction**

> Torque, speed, fuel use and efficiency curves are unknown. Internal configuration fields are not measured force, torque, watts or joules.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/470/limitations/4`

**Definition-only extraction**

> Mechanical power sharing between the two ports is unknown.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/470/limitations/5`

**Definition-only extraction**

> rotor_coaxial_light: attributes.force_emitter_max_force. Selected propeller/rotor configuration. This is not measured thrust in newtons.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/470/findings/10/detail`

**Definition-only extraction**

> rotor_coaxial_small: attributes.force_emitter_max_force. Selected propeller/rotor configuration. This is not measured thrust in newtons.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/470/findings/25/detail`

**Definition-only extraction**

> rotor_coaxial_large: attributes.force_emitter_max_force. Selected propeller/rotor configuration. This is not measured thrust in newtons.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/470/findings/40/detail`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.
title: Through-drive Rotor: decode remaining behavior and formulas
